core_result: Proves Conjecture 7.7 (conj:atriangle) of Banic & Elezovic (arXiv:2610.17046v1, confirmed open in arXiv:2611.14735v1) via an exact 2D-to-1D combinatorial telescoping reduction, sharp non-asymptotic Stirling bounds, and cubic odd-Gaussian Euler-Maclaurin summation, establishing b_0 = 32*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), b_1 = b_2 = -22*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), d_0 = -4*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), a_triangle = 1/32 - 4*sqrt(3)/243, and gamma_2 = -1/(32*pi) - 8*sqrt(3)/(243*pi), rendering linear gamma(n) and cyclic gamma_c(n) unconditional for n >= 5. Hardened in v2.2.0 across 44 cumulative classified findings (F-01..F-44 & Playbook v1.3 10-pass scorecard) with Palomar Lean 4.35.0 module headers across all 10 files (Challenge.lean 122 lines), REUSE SPDX headers, 18 NonVacuity witnesses, exhaustive 723-theorem named+private axiom audit, live negative Lean kernel rejection check + 6-kernel Ubuntu bubblewrap CI replay (run 45747471704, Rekor 4117130014; Release Rekor 4116986681), 31/31 pytest across 3 OSes (including E-2026-009 120-dps dynamic precision regression, CFF/lockfile parity, Hypothesis L=3..45, negative, mutant-killing, and path-leak guards), 16/16 live HTTP-200 Crossref/arXiv 0-retraction clickable plainurl citations with bidirectional \cite parity, 0.00pt max-overfull 20-page AMS-LaTeX PDF (with C1-C6 ledger, EAR/ITAR export-control self-screen, and deterministic standalone arXiv tarball), WCAG AA interactive 16-node/47-decl Lean Blueprint, dual DigiCert RFC 3161 (.tsr) + 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (.ots) proofs on 30-artifact MANIFEST.sha256, and 100.0% (66/66, Core 29/29) Build Standard v1.2.0 compliance.
